theorems.name: Submission.fiw_tb_lcc_face_integral_pos
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ) (F : LatticeFaceIndex n N) (g : Eucl N → ℝ) (p : Eucl N), 0 < ρ → Continuous g → (∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) → 0 < g p → (∀ i : Fin N, (i ∈ range F.2 → ρ * (F.1 i : ℝ) < p i ∧ p i < ρ * ((F.1 i : ℝ) + 1)) ∧ (i ∉ range F.2 → p i = ρ * (F.1 i : ℝ))) → 0 < ∫ x in latticeFace ρ F, g x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl N))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
